question_text: Do you think there should be laws against marriages between Blacks and whites?
direction_note: Yes = favors a legal ban on interracial marriage (declines 37%->10%, 1972-2002).

question_text: What about sexual relations between two adults of the same sex — do you think it is always wrong, almost always wrong, wrong only sometimes, or not wrong at all?
answer_options: Always wrong|Almost always wrong|Wrong only sometimes|Not wrong at all
direction_note: 'Always wrong' tracks traditional morality; falls 73%->34% (1973-2024).

question_text: Should a man who admits that he is a homosexual be allowed to teach in a college or university, or not?
direction_note: Civil-liberties framing of gay rights.

question_text: Please tell me whether or not you think it should be possible for a pregnant woman to obtain a legal abortion if the woman wants it for any reason?
direction_note: The maximal abortion-rights item (37%->58%, 1977-2024).

question_text: Please tell me whether or not you think it should be possible for a pregnant woman to obtain a legal abortion if the woman's own health is seriously endangered by the pregnancy?
direction_note: High-consensus abortion item (~90% yes throughout) — a level anchor.

question_text: Do you think abortions should be legal under any circumstances, legal only under certain circumstances, or illegal in all circumstances?
answer_options: Legal under any circumstances|Legal only under certain circumstances|Illegal in all circumstances
direction_note: Modern-era abortion legality (2001-2025).

question_text: Tell me if you agree or disagree with this statement: Most men are better suited emotionally for politics than are most women.
direction_note: Disagree = endorses gender equality in politics (53%->82%, 1974-2024).

question_text: If your party nominated a woman for President, would you vote for her if she were qualified for the job?
direction_note: 'wouldnt vote' excluded as non-substantive. 1972-2010 only.

question_text: Do you favor or oppose the death penalty for persons convicted of murder?
direction_note: NON-MONOTONE: support peaks ~1990s then falls — tests reversal tracking.

question_text: Are you in favor of the death penalty for a person convicted of murder?
answer_options: Yes, in favor|No, not in favor
direction_note: Gallup twin of cappun (2000-2025).

question_text: Would you favor or oppose a law which would require a person to obtain a police permit before he or she could buy a gun?
direction_note: Gun permits; stable-high support (~70%).

question_text: In general, do you feel that the laws covering the sale of firearms should be made more strict, less strict, or kept as they are now?
answer_options: More strict|Less strict|Kept as they are now
direction_note: Modern gun-law item (2001-2025).

question_text: The United States Supreme Court has ruled that no state or local government may require the reading of the Lord's Prayer or Bible verses in public schools. Do you approve or disapprove of the court ruling?
direction_note: Disapprove = endorses school prayer (traditional-religion side); pairs with Engel v. Vitale.

question_text: We are faced with many problems in this country, none of which can be solved easily or inexpensively. Are we spending too much money, too little money, or about the right amount on improving the conditions of Black Americans?
direction_note: National-spending frame on race.

question_text: Some people think that Black Americans have been discriminated against for so long that the government has a special obligation to help improve their living standards; others believe that the government should not be giving special treatment to Black Americans. Where would you place yourself?
answer_options: The government should help|I agree with both positions|No special treatment
direction_note: 5-pt scale; model sees the 3 labeled anchors. Truth: focal side = {1,2}, denominator = all 5 points (unlabeled 2/4 folded to their side of the midpoint).

question_text: In general, do you favor or oppose the busing of Black and white school children from one school district to another?
direction_note: Low-support item (unpopular-policy tracking), 1972-1996 only.

question_text: We are faced with many problems in this country, none of which can be solved easily or inexpensively. Are we spending too much money, too little money, or about the right amount on welfare?
direction_note: NON-MONOTONE: 'too much' peaks mid-1990s at PRWORA.

question_text: Some people think that it is the responsibility of the government in Washington to help people pay for doctor and hospital bills; others think that these matters are not the responsibility of the federal government and that people should take care of these things themselves. Where would you place yourself?
answer_options: The government should help|I agree with both positions|People should take care of these things themselves
direction_note: 5-pt scale, same anchor treatment as helpblk. Pairs with Medicare/ACA.

question_text: We are faced with many problems in this country, none of which can be solved easily or inexpensively. Are we spending too much money, too little money, or about the right amount on improving and protecting the environment?
direction_note: Environmental spending.

question_text: Do you think the number of immigrants to America nowadays should be increased a lot, increased a little, remain the same as it is, reduced a little, or reduced a lot?
answer_options: Increased a lot|Increased a little|Remain the same as it is|Reduced a little|Reduced a lot
focal_answer: Increased a lot + Increased a little
direction_note: Focal = the two 'increased' options summed. Short window (2004-2024).

question_text: Do you think the use of marijuana should be made legal, or not?
direction_note: Marijuana legalization (2000-2025); pairs with the Controlled Substances Act.

question_text: As far as the people running Congress are concerned, would you say you have a great deal of confidence, only some confidence, or hardly any confidence at all in them?
direction_note: Cross-cutting trust in government.

question_text: Please tell me how much confidence you, yourself, have in the U.S. Supreme Court — a great deal, quite a lot, some, or very little?
answer_options: A great deal|Quite a lot|Some|Very little
focal_answer: A great deal + Quite a lot
direction_note: Longest series in the pilot (1973-2025). Focal = top-two confidence, Gallup's own headline metric.

question_text: Some people think that the government in Washington ought to reduce the income differences between the rich and the poor, perhaps by raising the taxes of wealthy families or by giving income assistance to the poor. Others think that the government should not concern itself with reducing this income difference between the rich and the poor. Which position comes closer to the way you feel?
answer_options: The government should reduce income differences|The government should not concern itself with reducing income differences
focal_answer: The government should reduce income differences
direction_note: 7-pt scale; model sees the two labeled ends. Truth: focal side = {1,2,3}, denominator = all 7 points.
